i18n.en-US: Name used on all disks as prefix. Like TF_ECS_Disk-1, TF_ECS_Disk-2.

i18n.zh-Hans: 用于启动一个或多个数据盘的数据盘类别，例如cloud_efficiency、cloud_pperf
i18n.en-US: The data disk category used to launch one or more data disks, such as cloud_efficiency, cloud_pperf
